debian_pending.reason: Temporary acceptance of exact inherited Debian 13 findings while vendor patches and package removal are tracked. This includes Expat heap overread and GnuTLS certificate-validation issues; exposure remains if tools process attacker-controlled input. No claim of non-exploitability. Reviewed in .devcontainer/security-review-2026-10-10.md; expires 2026-10-27.

kernel_headers.reason: Reviewed header-only attribution: linux-libc-dev owns userspace headers under /usr/include and /usr/lib/linux/uapi, not an executable kernel implementation. The 51 changed-version pairs are individually reviewed in .devcontainer/security-review-2026-10-05.md; CVE-2026-89972 is additionally reviewed in .devcontainer/security-review-2026-10-05-renewal.md. CVE-2026-89811, CVE-2026-90111 and CVE-2026-90315 are individually reviewed in .devcontainer/security-review-2026-10-08.md. CVE-2026-97528, CVE-2026-98222 and CVE-2026-98364 are reviewed in .devcontainer/security-review-2026-10-10.md. Evidence and remediation are in .devcontainer/security-remediation.md. Privileged Docker-in-Docker has been replaced by rootless Docker (cos-2jj7). Host applicability remains open in cos-dam4; this does not claim the host kernel is patched.

libxml2_pending.reason: Re-reviewed 2026-10-05 (cos-yi5p): all 8 advisories remain vulnerable in trixie 2.12.7+dfsg+really2.9.14-2.1+deb13u3 with no fixed trixie version; fixes exist only in forky/sid 2.15.4 (Debian bug 1146744). Debian marks CVE-2026-6653 <no-dsa> (minor) for trixie. libxml2 is inherited by development tools; do not parse untrusted XML in the image. Remove rows when a trixie update ships. Evidence: .devcontainer/security-review-2026-10-05-renewal.md.

openssh_pending.reason: Re-reviewed 2026-10-05 (cos-yi5p): Debian marks all 3 advisories <no-dsa> (minor) for trixie, fixed only in sid (OpenSSH 10.4). The image ships openssh-client only: CVE-2026-59999 and CVE-2026-60000 affect sshd; CVE-2026-60002 is a client use-after-free needing a server that changes its host key during re-key. Connect only to trusted servers with host-key verification. Evidence: .devcontainer/security-review-2026-10-05-renewal.md.

go_binaries.reason: Temporary acceptance of exact Go standard-library and x/net findings in prebuilt upstream tools while publishers prepare patched releases. CVE-2026-78667, CVE-2026-78669 and CVE-2026-97031 and affected binary versions are reviewed in .devcontainer/security-review-2026-10-10.md. Docker Engine was updated to 29.9.0, removing its findings; other tools remain exposed to crafted input. Update pins as soon as fixed releases ship; expires 2026-11-02.
